title: Bleach’s Creator Had Its Ending in Mind From the Very Beginning
content: Bleach has finally come to an end with the right arc, giving the series the perfect ending fans had envisioned. What makes this ending even more special is that Tite Kubo had always envisioned his series concluding this way.
author: ComicBook

title: Korea Holds 1st AI Creative Contest for Children to Make Webtoons
content: Korea's Ministry of Science and ICT (MSIT) held the finals of its 2026 AI Creative Contest on October 24 at Kakao AI Campus, inviting young children and elementary school students to create stories, songs, and webtoons using artificial intelligence.
author: ANN

title: Expelled from Paradise -The Stellar Angel- Visual Novel's Video Previews Story, Systems, New Characters
content: The official website for the Expelled from Paradise -The Stellar Angel- ( Rakuen Tsuihō -The Stellar Angel- ) game began streaming a promotional video for the visual novel on Thursday. The video reveals the game's original story, systems, and the new characters Naamah and Aradia. Studio51 is developing the game.
author: ANN

title: No-Clipping My Way to Supremacy! TV Anime Reveals 7 Cast, More Staff
content: The official website for the television anime of Yui Hata 's No-Clipping My Way to Supremacy! manga, the adaptation of Nikita Kitagawa 's Saijakuna Boku wa "Kabenuke Bug" de Nariagaru: Kabe o Surinuketara, Shokai Clear Hōshū o Mugen Kaishū Dekimashita! novel series, revealed new cast and staff members on Thursday.
author: ANN

title: Shin Oishinbo TV Anime Reveals 6 New Cast Members, Theme Song Artists
content: The official website for Shin Oishinbo (New Oishinbo ), the new television anime series of storywriter Tetsu Kariya and artist Akira Hanasaki 's Oishinbo manga, revealed six new cast members and the artists for the anime's theme songs on Friday.
author: ANN

title: The Remarried Empress Webtoon Launches Side Stories Ahead of Disney+ Live-Action Series
content: Naver WEBTOON announced on October 28 that the The Remarried Empress webtoon will launch side stories on its Daily Plus service on October 29 at 10:00 p.m. KST. The new episodes will also be available on the platform's global services. Note: The below two paragraphs contain spoilers for the end of the webtoon series.

title: Good Smile Company: Full Credit Card Details for 2,800 Customers May Have Been Exposed in Data Breach
content: Good Smile Company released on Thursday a new update regarding the data breach on its online store where an "unauthorized third party" gained access to personal and other information if its members.
